Byte-exact inputs; `.gitattributes` and `.editorconfig` keep tools from rewriting them.

- `words/.ssh/`: a host named `list`, a host `web` with the alias `ls`, and `stg-consul1` with the
  alias `consul1.stg` under the label STAGING. Command words that are also hosts, and a host
  with every field, for the notes and the `inspect` text.
